plugin.name: Spring Boot
plugin.description: Spring Boot application detection, profiles and ports, startup failure diagnosis
opt.module.info: The Gradle subproject or Maven module that contains the application class.
opt.activeProfiles.info: Passed as -Dspring.profiles.active. When empty, spring.profiles.active from application.yml applies.
opt.launchMode.info: Direct: Gradle/Maven compiles and exports the classpath, then java starts the app, like IDEA. Build tool: uses bootRun or spring-boot:run; VM options are only supported with Maven.
opt.workingDir.info: Defaults to the directory of the module that contains the application class.
view.title: Application
view.defaultsInfo: Not running: derived from the configuration files for the default profiles.
err.noBuildTool: Spring Boot applications need a Gradle or Maven project
err.noMainClass: The run configuration has no main class
err.noJdk: No JDK is selected for this project
diag.failed.message: Spring Boot failed to start. See Description / Action for details.
diag.portInUse.title: Port {0} is in use
diag.dataSource.title: No data source configured
diag.dataSource.message: spring.datasource.url is not set for the active profiles. Usually a profile for the target environment must be selected.
diag.service.title: Cannot connect to {0}
diag.service.message: {0} address: {1} ({2}, from {3}). Make sure the service is running and reachable, or switch to another profile.
diag.service.unknown: No {0} address was found in the configuration files.
diag.dbAuth.title: {0} rejected the login
diag.redis.title: Cannot connect to Redis {1}:{2}
diag.redis.message: Check that Redis is running, or spring.data.redis.host / port (spring.redis.* in Boot 2).
diag.kafka.title: Cannot connect to Kafka {1}:{2}
diag.kafka.message: Check that Kafka is running, or spring.kafka.bootstrap-servers.
diag.rabbitmq.title: Cannot connect to RabbitMQ
diag.rabbitmq.message: Check that RabbitMQ is running, or spring.rabbitmq.host / port (default localhost:5672).
diag.elasticsearch.title: Cannot connect to Elasticsearch {1}
diag.elasticsearch.message: Check that Elasticsearch is running, or spring.elasticsearch.uris (default http://localhost:9200).
diag.mongodb.title: Cannot connect to MongoDB {1}
diag.mongodb.message: Check that MongoDB is running, or spring.data.mongodb.uri.
diag.livereload.title: LiveReload port is in use
diag.livereload.message: Another application with DevTools is running. This application is not affected.
fix.killPort: Stop the process using the port
fix.killPort.confirm: Stop the process listening on port {0}?
fix.noProfiles: This application has no profiles to choose
